verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's public API documents a dedicated "Create Campaign" endpoint with private-key/OAuth authentication and SDKs for server-side languages, supporting programmatic campaign creation. However, evidence does not confirm a documented API endpoint for scheduling/sending the created campaign (only creation is shown), so the full create-and-schedule flow isn't fully evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documented scheduling/send-triggering endpoint, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the entire flow works end-to-end without dashboard interaction.
